name: Gmina Gdów (Poland)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the ratio 4:1:1, the upper red charged towards the hoist with a white griffin with a sword, the charge from the gmina arms.
history: Established by resolution No. LIV/397/2014 of the gmina council of 22 May 2014, designed by Włodzimierz Chorązki and Mariusz Paluch; it replaced an earlier flag established on 5 November 1992.

features.role: griffin with a sword from the gmina arms
